profile.summary: Ava Community Energy is a local, not-for-profit public agency, formed as a joint powers authority, that supplies electricity to homes, businesses and public accounts in Alameda County and parts of San Joaquin County in California. PG&E still delivers the power and handles billing. It is governed by a board of local elected officials from the communities it serves.
